title: Fixed Split-Clamp Bicycle Repair Stand
description: Original S01 static service stand with linked long stabilizing feet, a fixed braced raised arm and two separately editable split clamp jaws. The inner eight-sided clamp surfaces match the measured seat-tube section of transport-city-bicycle-01 in the documented fixed elevated display pose, with its unchanged wheels and deployed kickstand clear of the floor. A visible fixed screw and hand knob identify the clamp. No lifting trajectory, clamp actuation, load rating or repair simulation is provided.
